value.rationale: The 4D bidisc is a canonical natural nonsmooth convex body. Its exact random central-section diameter law, with a striking positive π/4 endpoint atom and a genuinely continuous remaining part, gives a complete benchmark and structural contrast with smooth ellipsoids and polyhedral octahedra. Not merely a table recomputation or routine consequence of the motivating probability bounds; no arbitrary parameter slice.
